1.title: Plan Your Routine
1.description: Organize your workflow into ongoing Habits, recurring Dailies, and one-off To-Dos with checklists, hierarchical tags, and deadlines.

2.title: Execute on the 3:1 to 4:1 Ratio
2.description: Every deliverable and focus session follows a 3:1 to 4:1 balance: ~3–4 productive hours (~15 🪙) earn 1h of rest. Choose Coins/XP (Adventure) or Credits/Points (Essential).

3.title: Reward Your Dedication
3.description: Price your personal rewards fairly in the Store (e.g., 30m = 8 🪙, 1h = 15 🪙) or open Mystery Boxes in Adventure Mode.

4.title: Enjoy Guilt-Free
4.description: Use your redeemed items from Inventory/Backpack, enjoy well-earned leisure with peace of mind, and sustain long-term discipline.

v14.title: Atmospheric Themes, Friend Network, Privacy & Retrospective
v14.summary: Customize your workspace across 7 themes, connect with friends using granular privacy controls, and export collectible PNG journey cards.
highlights: 7 Visual Themes: 4 Free (Cosmic Dark, Cosmic Daylight, Dark Knight, and Solar Parchment) + 3 VIP (Cyberpunk Neon, Forest Ranger, and Royal Gold)
Friend Network (/friends) by @username or unique HP-XXXXXX code, Public Showcases, and social activity bell notifications
Granular Privacy Controls (Public, Friends Only, or Private) for profile visibility, stats, streaks, and request permissions
Seasonal Annual Retrospective (Dec 20 – Jan 31) with 5 behavioral archetypes and downloadable PNG Profile & Retrospective cards
Rich-Text task descriptions, Hierarchical Tags (>), inline Quick Focus on task rows, and unified 'All Workspaces' Dashboard view
Automatic timezone sync so daily rollovers, streak checks, and reminders align with midnight in your local region

v13.title: Task-Linked Focus, Kanban Events & Bulk Ledger Control
v13.summary: Link Pomodoro timers directly to tasks, schedule timed events on your board, and manage transaction history in bulk.
highlights: Task-linked Focus timer with 1-click start, per-card time history, and optional auto-completion
To-Dos as Events (VIP) with start/end times or all-day schedules and a live 'In progress' board badge
Bulk History deletion with original Kanban column snapshots preserved even if boards change later
Cross-Workspace Search and global 12h AM/PM or 24h time format synchronization

v12.title: Daylight Theme, 63 Achievements & Profile Showcase
v12.summary: Crisp daytime reading theme, complete trophy progression, and a customizable profile showcase.
highlights: High-contrast Cosmic Daylight light theme with quick toggle in the sidebar
63 permanent Achievements across 5 rarity tiers (including 8 secret medals) with prestige points
Profile Showcase (/profile) with custom bio, 4 trophy highlight slots, and Visitor View preview

v11.title: Essential vs. Adventure Modes & Bilingual Support
v11.summary: Switch between executive productivity or RPG immersion and change languages anytime.
highlights: Two Experience Modes: Essential Mode (Credits, Points & clean UI) or Adventure Mode (Gold Coins, XP & Mystery Boxes)
Full English (EN) and Portuguese (PT-BR) support across the entire application
Configurable email deadline reminders for To-Dos

v15.title: Parties & Cooperative Daily Quests
v15.summary: Team up in small squads of 4 to 6 friends to stay consistent together and earn shared bonuses.
highlights: Fast squad creation via invite code with a live team daily consistency dashboard
Cooperative Daily Quests with shared bonus rewards when every member completes their goals
Shared vault and exclusive team loyalty badges

v16.title: Real-Time Chat & Live Focus Presence
v16.summary: See when friends or squadmates are actively focusing and send quick encouragement without leaving flow.
highlights: Integrated Party chat and direct messages between connected friends
Live focus presence indicators (focusing, on break, available) with Do Not Disturb mode
1-click motivational reactions during Pomodoro sessions

v20.title: Native Mobile App, Thematic Guilds & World Bosses
v20.summary: Carry HabitParty in your pocket with native widgets and join community-wide discipline challenges.
highlights: Native iOS & Android app with home-screen widgets, quick check-ins, and live desktop Focus sync
Large thematic Guilds organized by goals (Studying, Coding, Fitness, Languages)
Cooperative World Boss events that take damage as the community logs focus and finishes tasks
Seasonal consistency leaderboards among friends and guilds
